To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we propose a new method to visualize feature importance in machine learning models, which can be used for both global and local feature importance and which allows to compare the feature contribution of different models.

the proposed PI and ICI plots are useful visual tools to assess the importance of a feature and to understand the model behavior, and that Shapley feature importances can be used to fairly compare the importance of features across different models.

we propose two novel visualizations for the expected (conditional feature) importance, which can be obtained from model-agnostic methods, and that we propose a new feature importance measure for model comparison.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a local feature importance, a global feature importance, and a feature importance comparison across models.

the development of new methods for visualizing and comparing the feature importance of black box models, as well as a new feature importance measure that is related to the Shapley value in game theory.
the visualization of the expected conditional feature importance for black box models and the development of a Shapley feature measure.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our method is a general framework that combines the advantages of global feature importance and partial dependence plots.

we provide an important contribution to the field of model-agnostic global and local feature importance measures, which is a crucial step to understand and improve the performance of black box models.
we propose a novel local feature importance measure and two visual tools for model-agnostic feature importance analysis, which are closely related to existing approaches.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a novel method for local feature importance, which is closely related to existing methods for local and global feature importance.
we propose a new method to visualize the expected feature importance for black box models, which is related to the well-known PD and ICE plots.
our proposed PI and ICI plots provide a new perspective for visualizing and understanding the behavior of black box models.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the proposed methods can be used to understand the model behavior, to detect unexpected behavior, to compare the importance of different features, to compare the behavior of different models, to identify important features for individual observations, and to identify observations with unusual behavior.
the feature importance of individual observations can be visualized and compared to the global feature importance, and this can help to understand how a model makes predictions.
the proposed visualizations provide a more complete and transparent view on the model performance compared to the traditional model-agnostic feature importance measures.
